reference_sql:
WITH campaign_spend AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.channel_id
),
ranked AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT channel_id, campaign_id, spend,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY spend DESC, campaign_id) AS rn
  FROM campaign_spend
)
SELECT channel_id, campaign_id, spend
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
alternatives:
WITH campaign_spend AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.channel_id
)
SELECT cs.channel_id, cs.campaign_id, cs.spend
FROM campaign_spend cs
WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_spend cs2
       WHERE cs2.channel_id = cs.channel_id
         AND (cs2.spend > cs.spend OR (cs2.spend = cs.spend AND cs2.campaign_id < cs.campaign_id))) < 3

SELECT t.channel_id, t.campaign_id, t.spend
FROM (
  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT c.channel_id, c.campaign_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.channel_id ORDER BY SUM(a.spend) DESC, c.campaign_id) AS rn
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, c.campaign_id
) AS t
WHERE t.rn <= 3

solver.query:
WITH camp AS (
  SELECT c.channel_id, c.campaign_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, c.campaign_id
),
r AS (
  SELECT channel_id, campaign_id, spend,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY spend DESC, campaign_id ASC) AS rn
  FROM camp
)
SELECT channel_id, campaign_id, spend
FROM r
WHERE rn <= 3
